description: A service team needs to know which bins are damaged, missing labels, temporarily removed, replaced, or assigned to the wrong customer so asset status stops drifting from reality. All service accounts are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old field coordinator responsible for container service records
user_profile.context: Asset notes exist, but they have not stayed synchronized with what crews are actually seeing in the field
user_profile.communication_style: Status-heavy and concrete, wants each container tied to one current operational state

fact_sheet.fact: Recycling container EC-R-4590, located at Summit Ridge Apartments, was reported as 'Damaged' on 2023-11-03 due to a cracked lid.
General waste container EC-G-1121 at 450 Oak Lane is flagged as 'Missing Label' in the AssetTrack Pro system as of 2023-11-05.
Organics container EC-O-3301 was 'Temporarily Removed' from the Pine Street Farmer's Market on 2023-10-28 for a city event and is due back on 2023-11-12.
Recycling container EC-R-7834 was 'Replaced' at the Maplewood Eatery on 2023-10-30; the old, damaged unit was decommissioned.
General waste container EC-G-5822 is currently 'Misassigned'; it is physically located at 789 Birchwood Ave but is assigned to 791 Birchwood Ave in the system.
Container EC-R-2045 at the Cypress Medical Clinic has its right-side wheel broken, logged under service ticket T-9811.
As of the last service on 2023-11-06, container EC-G-8150 at the public library is fully 'Operational'.
Container EC-O-6755, assigned to the 'Grove Cafe', was reported as 'Missing' on 2023-11-01 and has not been located.
The service address for container EC-R-4591 is 1200 Summit Ridge Dr, Apartment Complex B, rear loading dock.
The lock on secure document container EC-S-0042 at City Hall is jammed; a maintenance request was filed on 2023-11-04.
The 'Maplewood Eatery' account (CID: CUST-045) is assigned two containers: one general waste (EC-G-1122) and one recycling (EC-R-7834).
'Summit Ridge Apartments' (CID: CUST-089) has a contract for twelve 96-gallon recycling containers and eight 96-gallon general waste containers.
Account CUST-102, 'Oak Lane Retail', has an open service request (T-9755) for graffiti removal that is 14 days old.
The primary service contact for 'Cypress Medical Clinic' (CID: CUST-015) is Facilities Manager, David Chen, at 555-018-2345.
A new service account, 'Riverbend Tech Park' (CID: CUST-211), was created on 2023-11-02 and is awaiting initial container deployment.
Service ticket T-9811 was created on 2023-11-02 by crew member Maria Flores to report the broken wheels on container EC-R-2045.
Ticket T-9820 for replacing the missing RFID label on container EC-G-1121 is assigned to the 'Labeling Team' with a due date of 2023-11-10.
Ticket T-9799, for replacing the damaged container at Maplewood Eatery, was closed on 2023-10-30 by supervisor Kenji Tanaka.
The status of ticket T-9811 (broken wheels) is 'On Hold - Awaiting Parts', specifically waiting for an axle replacement kit.
The last note added to ticket T-9820 at 9:15 AM on 2023-11-06 by Sarah Jenkins reads: 'Confirmed location with customer, crew can access M-F 8am-4pm'.
The standard general waste container (EC-G series) has a capacity of 96 gallons and is manufactured by 'DuraBin Inc'.
Organics containers (EC-O series) are 32-gallon capacity and are colored green for easy identification by collection crews.
Recycling container EC-R-7834 was placed into service on 2023-10-30 and has an expected service life of 10 years.
All containers are equipped with a passive RFID tag (model: Omni-ID Fit 400) for asset tracking during collection.
The total count of active containers managed by the West Metro district is 4,281 as of 2023-11-01.
Sarah Jenkins is the Field Coordinator responsible for maintaining the accuracy of the AssetTrack Pro database for the West Metro district.
Crew member Maria Flores operates collection truck #17 on Route WM-04, which covers the downtown commercial sector.
All container repair and replacement tickets must be approved by Maintenance Supervisor Kenji Tanaka before parts are ordered.
The on-call number for after-hours service emergencies is 555-012-7000, monitored by the shift lead.
The login URL for the asset management system is https://ecocycle.assettrackpro.com/login.
Any service ticket with the priority 'Critical', such as a leaking container, must be acknowledged by a supervisor within 60 minutes.
All collection crews are required to sync their handheld scanners with the AssetTrack Pro system by 5:00 PM at the end of each shift.
